Definition: a section (half) of a shekel, i.e. a beka (a weight and a coin)
BiblicalUsage: beka — a half-shekel, a beka — it shows up twice, in Genesis 24:22 and Exodus 38:26.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that beka shows how carefully God chose His words — nothing in Scripture is filler.
